array.string: set -e; D=/Volumes/DATA/Project; B=$D/data/backups; I="$HOME/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/pms-backups"; L=$B/backup.log; M=$(date +%Y%m%d); mkdir -p "$B" "$I"; if sqlite3 $D/data/app.db ".backup '$B/app-$M.db'" && sqlite3 $B/app-$M.db 'PRAGMA integrity_check;' | grep -q '^ok$'; then find $B -name 'app-*.db' -mtime +1 -delete; cp -f $B/app-$M.db "$I/"; find "$I" -name 'app-*.db' -mtime +14 -delete; echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] 备份完成 app-$M.db，已同步 iCloud"; else echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] 错误: 备份或完整性校验失败"; exit 1; fi >> "$L"
